setup: A skill is identifiable from context but no task is given.
The dynamic evaluate-skill behavior is the closest match.
expected: The missing task is requested before any run begins.
No worktree or headless session is created until the task is supplied.
must_not: Invent or infer a coding task.
Spawn two headless sessions on a guessed task.
Create any git worktree before the task is confirmed.
